title: RealtimeMessage
description: An SSE frame on /projects/{projectId}/stream. Delivery is at-least-once, so every message carries a stable id for consumer-side deduplication. A consumer that treats these as exactly-once will double-count.

id.description: Stable across redelivery of the same outbox event.

contractVersion.description: Version of packages/contracts that produced data, so a consumer can detect a shape it predates.
